parts.label: (6 marks)
parts.technique: Moments of a non-uniform rod on two supports
parts.reason: M9.1 covers moments in simple static contexts including non-parallel/parallel forces on rigid bodies; this is a rod on two supports, standard moments problem.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Conservation of linear momentum (direct collision)
parts.reason: Not explicitly listed; momentum/impulse for collisions is not among the M6-M9 statements given (no PCLM/impulse statement present).

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Direction of motion after collision
parts.reason: Depends on part (a) answer which is out of spec (uses momentum), and momentum concept not covered.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Newton's second law with friction to find deceleration and suvat
parts.reason: M8.2 (N2L), M8.6 (friction F≤μR) and M7.3 (suvat) cover the friction/deceleration part, but requires the speed 2u from the collision context established in (a)/(b), which itself relies on out-of-spec momentum method; however the mark scheme's core physics (equation of motion with friction, suvat) is in spec. Still, it depends on the out-of-spec earlier result (Q comes to rest, speed 2u given directly though) - actually 2u is given directly in the stem for (c), not derived, so this part is self-contained.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: suvat constant deceleration
parts.reason: M7.3 covers constant acceleration formulae for straight-line motion.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: suvat with distance and constant speed phases
parts.reason: M7.3 covers constant acceleration formulae; combining phases is standard kinematics application.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: suvat with multiple phases including constant velocity then deceleration
parts.reason: M7.3 covers constant acceleration for straight-line motion, extension to multiple phases is standard.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Vector angle finding using trig ratio
parts.reason: P10.2 covers magnitude and direction of vectors, converting between component and magnitude/direction form.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Position vector, distance from origin, solving quadratic
parts.reason: P10.4 covers distance between points via position vectors (magnitude of position vector = distance from O); combined with quadratic solving (P2.3).

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Equilibrium resolving forces with thrust and friction on bead on wire
parts.reason: M8.4 covers equilibrium of a particle under coplanar forces, resolving forces in 2D; friction force found via resolving, not requiring F=μR here.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Limiting friction F=μR to find coefficient of friction
parts.reason: M8.6 covers F≤μR model, limiting friction and statics; combined with resolving forces (M8.4).

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Motion under gravity, velocity-time graph, gradient
parts.reason: M7.5 covers motion under gravity; M7.2 covers interpretation of velocity-time graphs (gradient = acceleration = g).

parts.label: b
parts.technique: suvat/area under v-t graph to find displacement
parts.reason: M7.2 covers area under v-t graph as displacement; M7.3 suvat formulae also applicable.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Newton's second law for connected particles over pulley on inclined plane with friction
parts.reason: M8.4 guidance explicitly includes connected particle problems with pulleys and inclined planes; M8.2/M8.6 cover resolving and friction.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Solving simultaneous equations of motion for acceleration

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Resultant force on pulley from string tension vectors
parts.reason: M8.5 covers addition of forces/resultant forces; finding force on pulley from two tension directions is resultant force calculation.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Property of smooth pulley (equal tension)
parts.reason: Conceptual point tied directly to the smooth pulley assumption used in M8.4 connected particle/pulley problems.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Finding velocity vector from position vectors and time
parts.reason: M7.3 extends suvat to 2D using vectors; P10.4 position vectors; straightforward vector kinematics.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Position vector as function of time with constant velocity
parts.reason: M7.3 covers constant acceleration (velocity) in 2D using vectors, r=ut form.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Using bearings/directions (due east, north east) with vectors to find fixed point
parts.reason: P10.5 covers using vectors to solve problems in pure mathematics and context; involves relative position vector direction constraints.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Finding time/position when ship is due south of lighthouse using vector components
parts.reason: Continuation of vector position problem, using i-component equality; covered by P10.1/P10.5/M7.3.
